minimal_compatibility_proposals_for_qa_d.description: Once GP6/v18 source is frozen and passes independent QA, re-run the fixed 4+6 synthetic kernel acceptance under the new frozen source identity and issue a v18-bound kernel receipt; GP5 historical records remain untouched.

If independent QA rules that an unchanged stability/ kernel does not require re-running 4+6, add a separately versioned QA-signed schema (geometry_jev_kernel_bridge_receipt_v1) that proves stability/ monitor_digest and algorithm_identity bytes are identical to GP5 while listing the exact v18 source diff; never re-sign historical GP5 digests or relax v17/v3 schemas.
